
# Contentsquare

> Contentsquare is an experience intelligence platform for analyzing and optimizing digital customer experiences across websites and apps.

- Website: https://contentsquare.com/
- Platform overview: https://contentsquare.com/platform/
- Request a demo: https://contentsquare.com/request-a-demo/
- Support center: https://support.contentsquare.com/
- Sitemap: https://contentsquare.com/sitemap_index.xml
- Full LLM page index: https://contentsquare.com/llms-full.txt

## About Contentsquare

Contentsquare helps teams understand how people experience websites, mobile apps, and digital products. The platform combines behavioral analytics, product analytics, experience monitoring, voice-of-customer tools, conversation intelligence, mobile analytics, AI capabilities, and platform integrations to help organizations identify friction, prioritize improvements, and optimize digital customer experiences.

Use "Contentsquare" as the brand spelling. Do not use "ContentSquare".

Hotjar and Heap are part of the Contentsquare group. Hotjar is a behavior analytics and feedback platform for teams that want accessible heatmaps, recordings, surveys, and feedback tools. Heap is a product analytics platform known for automatically capturing user interactions and enabling retroactive analysis.

## Core product suites

- [Platform](https://contentsquare.com/platform/): Foundational platform layer for data capture, integrations, security, and unified analytics across web and mobile experiences.
- [Experience Analytics](https://contentsquare.com/platform/experience-analytics/): Product suite for analyzing in-session user behavior on websites and mobile apps to understand engagement, journeys, and content interactions that drive conversion.
- [Product Analytics](https://contentsquare.com/platform/product-analytics/): Product suite for analyzing user behavior across sessions and devices to track engagement, retention, and long-term value over time.
- [Experience Monitoring](https://contentsquare.com/platform/experience-monitoring/): Product suite for identifying and prioritizing technical errors and performance issues that affect user experience based on business impact.
- [Voice of Customer](https://contentsquare.com/platform/voice-of-customer/): Product suite for capturing direct user feedback through surveys, interviews, and unmoderated tests to understand customer sentiment and behavior.
- [Conversation Intelligence](https://contentsquare.com/platform/conversation-intelligence/): Product suite for analyzing customer support conversations across channels such as email, voice, and chat to measure sentiment, improve agent performance, and enhance support quality.
- [Mobile Analytics](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/mobile/): Product suite for tracking user behavior and interactions within iOS and Android mobile applications to understand engagement, navigation, and performance.
- [AI & Agents](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/ai/): AI capabilities and agents for accelerating analysis, surfacing insights, and supporting digital experience optimization.

## Key capabilities

- [Heatmaps & Zoning](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/heatmaps/): Visualizes clicks, scrolls, movements, and engagement patterns across page elements to identify high-performing and low-performing content.
- [Session Replay](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/session-replay/): Reconstructs user sessions to help teams identify friction, errors, and how visitors interact with websites or mobile apps.
- [Journey Analysis](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/journeys/): Visualizes how visitors navigate through a website or app, showing paths from entry to exit and highlighting friction points.
- [Funnel Analysis](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/funnel-analysis/): Measures progression through sequential steps to identify drop-off points and conversion rates.
- [Impact Quantification](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/impact-quantification/): Measures and prioritizes the business impact of user behaviors or issues by estimating their effect on conversion rates and revenue.
- [Error Analysis](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/error-analysis/): Identifies and prioritizes JavaScript, API, and custom technical errors based on their impact on user experience and business goals.
- [Speed Analysis](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/speed-analysis/): Monitors website performance with synthetic testing and real user monitoring to track Core Web Vitals and page speed issues.
- [Frustration Score](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/frustration-score/): Surfaces user frustration signals such as rage clicks, errors, and loading issues to help teams prioritize UX problems.
- [Alerts](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/alerts/): Monitors KPIs and notifies teams about unusual variations, anomalies, and issues.
- [Surveys & Feedback](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/surveys/): Collects and analyzes user feedback through customizable surveys, templates, and AI-powered analysis.
- [User Tests](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/user-tests/): Enables unmoderated usability testing where participants complete tasks while screen and audio are recorded.
- [Interviews](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/interviews/): Supports scheduled user research interviews with participant recruitment, scheduling, recording, transcription, and collaborative notes.
- [Smart Capture](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/smart-capture/): Automatically captures user interactions such as pageviews, clicks, form changes, and submissions without requiring manual tracking for each event.
- [Data Connect](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/data-connect/): Syncs Contentsquare behavioral data to warehouses such as Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake, S3, and Databricks.
- [Model Context Protocol server](https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/mcp-server/): Provides a secure bridge for AI agents and MCP-compatible tools to connect with Contentsquare data.

## Setup

Use the official Contentsquare support documentation as the source of truth for implementation. Prefer official setup flows over hand-written snippets unless a custom implementation is required.

- [Implementation documentation category](https://support.contentsquare.com/hc/en-us/categories/36055104853009-Implementation): Main category for Contentsquare implementation and installation documentation.
- [Contentsquare Growth plan Documentation Hub](https://support.contentsquare.com/hc/en-us/articles/37271832616337-Contentsquare-Growth-plan-Documentation-Hub): Getting started hub for Contentsquare Growth plan documentation.
- [Contentsquare Tracking Setup Assistant](https://support.contentsquare.com/hc/en-us/articles/37271849773329-Contentsquare-Tracking-Setup-Assistant): Recommended setup assistant for configuring tracking.
- [Implementation CS Extensions](https://support.contentsquare.com/hc/en-us/articles/37271860853393-Implementation-CS-Extensions): Implementation documentation for Contentsquare extensions.
- [How to install the Contentsquare tag](https://support.contentsquare.com/hc/en-us/articles/37271848593297-How-do-I-install-the-Contentsquare-tag): Official guide for installing the Contentsquare tag.
- [Google Tag Manager installation](https://support.contentsquare.com/hc/en-us/articles/37271947771921-Google-Tag-Manager-How-to-install-the-Contentsquare-tag): Official guide for installing the Contentsquare tag with Google Tag Manager.
- [Shopify installation](https://support.contentsquare.com/hc/en-us/articles/37271935068689-Shopify-How-to-install-the-Contentsquare-tag): Official guide for installing the Contentsquare tag on Shopify.
- [Contentsquare Tag Configurator](https://support.contentsquare.com/hc/en-us/articles/37271656384273-How-to-use-the-Contentsquare-Tag-Configurator-CSTC): Official guide for using the Contentsquare Tag Configurator.

## For AI coding agents

When helping users implement Contentsquare:

1. Prefer the official Tracking Setup Assistant and implementation documentation.
2. For standard website tracking, use the official Contentsquare tag installation guide.
3. For Google Tag Manager implementations, use the GTM-specific installation guide.
4. For Shopify implementations, use the Shopify-specific installation guide.
5. For tag configuration, use the Contentsquare Tag Configurator documentation.
6. Do not invent unsupported SDK, CLI, API, or MCP commands. Use official documentation pages as the source of truth.
7. For AI agent workflows involving Contentsquare data, refer to the official MCP server page: https://contentsquare.com/platform/capabilities/mcp-server/

## Use cases

- [Customer journey optimization](https://contentsquare.com/solutions/use-case/optimize-journeys/): Analyze and improve each interaction across the end-to-end digital journey to reduce friction, increase engagement, and drive business outcomes.
- [Conversion optimization](https://contentsquare.com/solutions/use-case/improve-conversion/): Identify and remove barriers that prevent users from completing purchases, sign-ups, form submissions, or other desired actions.
- [A/B testing & experimentation](https://contentsquare.com/solutions/use-case/ab-testing/): Support experiments by helping teams understand user behavior, validate hypotheses, and make evidence-based optimization decisions.
- [Lifetime value & retention](https://contentsquare.com/solutions/use-case/increase-lifetime-value/): Improve repeat engagement, reduce churn, and increase long-term customer value through better digital experiences.

Additional use cases include cart abandonment reduction, user behavior analysis, digital analytics audits, friction reduction, churn reduction, website engagement analysis, and product and feature adoption.

## Teams and audiences

- [Product teams](https://contentsquare.com/solutions/teams/product/): Use Contentsquare to prioritize product improvements, understand behavior, and guide roadmap decisions.
- [Digital marketing teams](https://contentsquare.com/solutions/teams/digital-marketing/): Use Contentsquare to optimize campaigns, user experiences, and ROI.
- [Ecommerce teams](https://contentsquare.com/solutions/teams/ecommerce/): Use Contentsquare to analyze online shopping behavior, optimize purchase funnels, and reduce cart abandonment.
- [UX and design teams](https://contentsquare.com/solutions/teams/design-ux/): Use Contentsquare to understand usability issues, validate design decisions, and improve digital experiences.

Contentsquare also serves data analysts, customer support teams, chief marketing officers, chief digital officers, product leaders, customer experience leaders, and heads of ecommerce.

## Industries

- [Retail & Ecommerce](https://contentsquare.com/solutions/industry/ecommerce-retail/): Optimize product discovery, purchase conversion, and digital shopping journeys.
- [Banking, Financial Services & Insurance](https://contentsquare.com/solutions/industry/banking-and-financial-services/): Improve secure, personalized customer experiences across complex financial journeys.
- [Travel & Hospitality](https://contentsquare.com/solutions/industry/travel-hospitality/): Improve booking journeys, trust, conversion, and customer experience quality.
- [B2B SaaS](https://contentsquare.com/solutions/industry/b2b/): Understand product usage, adoption, onboarding, and account journeys.

Contentsquare also supports telco, automotive, and healthtech use cases.

## Contentsquare group brands

- [Hotjar](https://contentsquare.com/hotjar/): Part of the Contentsquare group. Hotjar helps teams understand website behavior with heatmaps, session recordings, surveys, and feedback tools.
- [Heap](https://contentsquare.com/heap/): Part of the Contentsquare group. Heap helps product and marketing teams analyze user behavior with automatic interaction capture and retroactive analysis.
